# orion source

Sources that ingest imports work from

```sh
orion source <command> [options]
```

## orion source list

List configured sources

```sh
orion source list [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `--json` | Print JSON  |

## orion source add

Add a GitHub, Jira, or hop source

```sh
orion source add <command> [options]
```

### orion source add github

Add a GitHub source

```sh
orion source add github [options]
```

| Argument            | Description                              |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `--host <value>`    | GitHub host                              |
| `--owners <value>`  | GitHub owners, comma-separated           |
| `--include <value>` | Repositories to include, comma-separated |
| `--exclude <value>` | Repositories to exclude, comma-separated |
| `--id <value>`      | Source id                                |
| `--json`            | Print JSON                               |

### orion source add jira

Add a Jira source

```sh
orion source add jira [options]
```

| Argument            | Description                           |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `--command <value>` | JSON array naming an external command |
| `--browse <value>`  | Jira browse URL                       |
| `--id <value>`      | Source id                             |
| `--json`            | Print JSON                            |

### orion source add hop

Add a hop source

```sh
orion source add hop [options]
```

| Argument            | Description                           |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `--command <value>` | JSON array naming an external command |
| `--id <value>`      | Source id                             |
| `--json`            | Print JSON                            |

## orion source remove

Remove an ingestion source

```sh
orion source remove [id] [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `[id]`   | Source id   |
| `--json` | Print JSON  |

## orion source matches

List unplaced pull requests and the cards they likely belong to

```sh
orion source matches [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `--json` | Print JSON  |
